title: Backpropagation-free Deep Learning for Time-Series Classification
summary: Across UCR time-series datasets, the study finds that temporal variability tracks performance gaps for backpropagation-free learners, and pooling has different effects on DFA/DRTP versus NoProp relative to matched backpropagation controls.
ai_technology: DFA, DRTP and NoProp are adapted to 1D convolutional time-series models and compared with backpropagation controls.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: 112 datasets, official split plus five stratified resplits, six split averages, matched architecture and evaluation metrics
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
